about: Every line the TV app says out loud (ADR 0040). `say` goes to the voice; `show` is what the screen prints, the same words without the delivery tag. No child's name, ever (ADR 0034).

lines.say: [warmly] Pick one more. Then we're all done for today.
lines.show: Pick one more. Then we're all done for today.

lines.say: [warmly] Great watching! All done for today. See you tomorrow!
lines.show: Great watching! All done for today. See you tomorrow!

lines.say: [warmly] Time for a little break. See you soon!
lines.show: Time for a little break. See you soon!

lines.say: [softly] The videos are sleeping. They wake up in the morning. Good night!
lines.show: The videos are sleeping. They wake up in the morning. Good night!

lines.say: [warmly] A grown-up says that's all for now. See you soon!
lines.show: A grown-up says that's all for now. See you soon!
